name: Parcelhead
idea: The universal running pictogram, built on a strict stroke grammar, with a taped parcel in place of its head: a courier who is the delivery.
why: Everyone already knows the running figure, so changing one shape makes it readable at 32 px and impossible to mistake for another carrier.
risks: It echoes the emergency-exit runner and can read as comic, and the signal pink (chosen over the suggested tangerine because orange belongs to Cargus) may feel too playful to conservative B2B clients.
